name: Dual-Path Polynomial + Residual Gate
tagline: Two GPRGNN-style monomial filters (uniform-init + PPR-init) mixed by a learnable scalar, with a sigmoid residual gate to the unfiltered features.
formula: $$h_1(\hat A) = \sum_{k=0}^{K}\theta^{(1)}_k \hat A^k,\quad h_2(\hat A) = \sum_{k=0}^{K}\theta^{(2)}_k \hat A^k,\quad \hat A = D^{-1/2}AD^{-1/2},$$ $$y = (1-\sigma(g))\,\big[\sigma(w)\,h_1(\hat A)x + (1-\sigma(w))\,h_2(\hat A)x\big] + \sigma(g)\,x,$$ with $\theta^{(1)}_k = 1/(K+1)$ (uniform), $\theta^{(2)}_k = \alpha(1-\alpha)^k$ (PPR).
diff_from_baseline: Versus GPRGNN, runs two independent monomial filters in parallel (uniform-init and PPR-init), convex-combines them with one learnable scalar, and adds a sigmoid skip-connection that pulls the output back toward x.

name: Adaptive D^{-a} A D^{-b} Polynomial
tagline: GPRGNN-style monomial filter where the adjacency normalization exponents (a, b) are learned via sigmoid, sliding between GCN-norm (1/2,1/2) and raw adjacency (0,0).
formula: $$a = \sigma(\tilde a),\ b = \sigma(\tilde b),\quad \tilde A_{ij} = D_i^{-a}\,A_{ij}\,D_j^{-b},\qquad h(\tilde A)x = \sum_{k=0}^{K}\gamma_k\,\tilde A^k x,\quad \gamma_k(\text{init}) = \tfrac{1}{K+1}.$$
init_recovers: GPRGNN-uniform with GCN normalization when a = b = 0.5
diff_from_baseline: Versus GPRGNN, replaces the fixed GCN-norm (a=b=1/2) with two learnable sigmoid-bounded normalization exponents shared across hops, so the model can interpolate to raw-adjacency on heterophilic graphs.

name: Favard Three-Term Recurrence Filter
tagline: Builds an orthonormal polynomial basis on the shifted Laplacian using a learnable three-term recurrence (alpha, beta, gamma), then linearly combines them.
formula: $$x^{(0)} = \frac{x}{\sqrt{\beta_0}},\qquad x^{(k+1)} = \frac{\tilde L\,x^{(k)} - \gamma_k\,x^{(k)} - \sqrt{\beta_k}\,x^{(k-1)}}{\sqrt{\beta_{k+1}}},\qquad y = \sum_{k=0}^{K}\alpha_k\,x^{(k)},$$ where $\tilde L = L - I$ and $\beta_k = \mathrm{softplus}(\tilde\beta_k)$.
init_recovers: Initial state matches a perturbed monomial polynomial basis on tilde L (close to GPRGNN with random coeffs)
diff_from_baseline: Versus ChebNetII (fixed Chebyshev 3-term recurrence), learns the recurrence coefficients beta and gamma per hop, producing an adaptive orthonormal Favard basis that the alpha weights then combine. NOTE: in the proposed `forward` the final linear-combination output is computed but not explicitly returned (the function ends after the loop), so the implementation looks slightly bugged.

name: Parity-Separated Dual-Spectrum Filter
tagline: Splits each hop into a low-pass branch (A^k x) and a high-pass branch (x − A^k x), gated per parity (even vs. odd hops) and finally blended with a residual.
formula: $$\mathrm{low}_k = \hat A^k x,\quad \mathrm{high}_k = x - \hat A^k x,\qquad b_k = \tanh(\bar b_k),\quad w^{lo}_k = \tfrac{1-b_k}{2},\ w^{hi}_k = \tfrac{1+b_k}{2},$$ $$g_e = \sigma(p_0),\ g_o = \sigma(p_1),\quad o = \sum_{k=0}^{K} g_{k\bmod 2}\,a_k\,(w^{lo}_k\mathrm{low}_k + w^{hi}_k\mathrm{high}_k),\quad y = (1-\sigma(r))o + \sigma(r)x.$$

key_hyperparams.name: band b_k
key_hyperparams.role: high vs low mix per hop (tanh)

init_recovers: Plain monomial GPRGNN at init when band = 0 and parity gates = 1
diff_from_baseline: Versus GPRGNN, every hop produces both a low-pass term (A^k x) and a complementary high-pass term (x − A^k x); per-hop tanh band and per-parity sigmoid gates let even and odd hops adopt different spectral roles, then a sigmoid residual blends the result with x.

name: Signed ChebNetII + Residual Gate
tagline: ChebNetII without the ReLU on interpolation values (so coefficients can be negative, enabling high-pass filters), plus a sigmoid residual gate to the encoded features.

key_hyperparams.name: residual_logit g
key_hyperparams.role: sigmoid blend of x and filtered output

diff_from_baseline: Versus ChebNetII, removes the ReLU on the interpolation values (so the filter can become high-pass) and adds a sigmoid residual gate that blends the filtered output with the original encoded features.
